title: Nchụso Ụlọikpe
intro: N'ime ụzọ ọchịchị, otu onye nwere ọkwa dị elu ghọrọ onye na-ejere ya ozi nke mara mma ya dị ka nke ụwa. Ịhụnanya a dugara n'ọtụtụ ihe ga-anwale iguzosi ike n'ihe, kpughee eziokwu zoro ezo, ma mechaa gosi na onye ohu ahụ dị ọcha.
clues: Ebi m n'ala Naịl, n'obí eze nwere mmetụta dị ukwuu.
Otu nwa okorobịa batara n'ụlọ m, ọnụnọ ya mekwara ka ụwa m ghara iru ala.
Agbalịrị m ịrata ya, mana ọ chọrọ ebe mgbaba n'ime Onyenwe ya.
Adọwara m uwe ya n'azụ, mana ihe akaebe gosiri na aghụghọ m bụ eziokwu.
Iji mechie asịrị ndị inyom a ma ama, akpọrọ m ha òkù ịbịa nzukọ ma tinye ihe ndị dị nkọ n'aka ha.
N'ikpeazụ, ekwupụtaara m mmejọ m n'ihu ọha, na-ekwupụta eziokwu ahụ n'ihu eze.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ọ nwara ịrata onye amụma Josef
Ọ gbalịrị igbu onye amụma Mozis
O kwuru na ya bụ chi nwanyị
O wuru ụlọ elu iji maa Allah aka
O duuru ndị agha megide Meka
trial.answer: Ọ nwara ịrata onye amụma Josef

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: O kwetara ma kweta eziokwu ahụ
E riri ya na ndị agha ya
outcome.answer: O kwetara ma kweta eziokwu ahụ

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
